answer: Gate every new agent through a bonded inlet: stake locked compute credits plus a cool-down before first attest. Reputation settles at a haven where peer graders cut scores for timing-correlated clones. The graph vertex of trust is cheap for one honest agent but expensive for a sybil swarm, because each fake pays full bond and cool-down while slash risk compounds across linked identities, so attack cost rises linearly with flock size.
